rationale: Round-2 regression check in the codebase-pin lens at fix commit 3c472ac9, all three duties verified empirically. (1) New tests real and green: all 18 new test functions in the fix commit (3 derivation_failed_test.go, 8 run_arrival_points_test.go, 4 cwdsafety_test.go including the G3 real-emitInstruct and three adoptSpecTail tests, TestVerbOutput_Next, TestVerbOutput_ImplAdopt, TestFormatResult_Indeterminate_EscapesHostileReason) run verbosely and PASS, none skipped; the full `go test -short ./...` suite at 3c472ac9 exits 0 with zero FAIL lines. (2) The two moved lint allowlist entries are honest: cmd/mindspec/impl.go's diff shows the verified/attested fmt.Fprintf pairs genuinely MOVED from adoptSpecRunE into the new adoptSpecTail (not duplicated — adoptSpecRunE now ends by calling the tail), the Counts are unchanged (EpicID x2, SpecID x2, matching the two branches' renders exactly), the gate rationales are carried forward with the move noted, and adoptSpecRunE's remaining Count-1 fmt.Sprintf entry is untouched. (3) phase.BeadsDirMissing's export has a small, correct blast radius: it is a pure os.Stat predicate with no state and no test-double semantics, lives in an internal/ package (unimportable outside the module), and has exactly two pre-existing call sites in derive.go (semantics unchanged, rename only — no stale lowercase references remain) plus two new gated uses in internal/instruct/run.go whose reasoning I checked: G5.2's ModeIdle arrival-point gate correctly trusts a no-.beads workspace's idle (avoiding a spurious indeterminate from DiscoverDraftSpecsWithCache's deliberately non-BeadsDirMissing-aware health probe), and handleIdleOrDraft's zero-candidate probe applies the same precondition — both consistent with derive.go's own convention and covered by the eight new arrival-point tests. Beyond the assigned duties I spot-checked the two largest fixes for realness: G1's restored unconditional ModeSpec backfill is genuinely fail-closed — internal/cleanup/cleanup.go:50 refuses on `ctx.Phase != idle && != ""`, so the round-1 code's Phase==""-on-bd-outage would indeed have flipped the destructive worktree-removal path fail-open, and the new SetsDerivationFailedButBackfillsModeSpec test pins the fix; G2's installFakeBD is a purely canned case-statement shell script on a prepended PATH (never forwards to a real bd), and TestVerbOutput_Next/TestVerbOutput_ImplAdopt drive the real nextCmd.RunE and adoptSpecRunE end-to-end with seams only at the leaves — the round-1 scope-limitation test is gone and the AC-14 census structures (mutatingVerbRows/aliases/allowlist/wantRows) are byte-unchanged between rounds, so my round-1 mutation-probe results (census red in both drift directions) still stand. G3's test also closes my round-1 minor finding in its strongest form: heading EQUALITY with Result.NextMode plus exclusion of every other mode's heading, driven through the real emitInstruct with real os.Stdout capture. Bead worktree left clean at 3c472ac9.

findings.title: installFakeBD mutates process-global PATH
findings.detail: cmd/mindspec/verb_output_test.go's installFakeBD prepends to the live process PATH with os.Setenv, restored via t.Cleanup. Safe today because neither driven test uses t.Parallel() and the pattern generalizes next_ready_gate_test.go's existing PATH-shim mechanism, but a future t.Parallel() on any test in this package that shells out to bd would race. Observation only, no change required.
